method: Candidate pool named by the operator and found by web search and the GitHub topic listing 'hexagonal-architecture' (the GitHub search API was not used; anonymous git clones through the session proxy). 33 distinct candidates probed (blobless clone: last commit, licence file, package.json licence, .ts counts). Inclusion, in order: (1) public, permissive licence (MIT/ISC/BSD/Apache) at the pinned commit; (2) TypeScript backend that claims the style in its README or folder structure; (3) pinned commit dated before 2023-01-01 (the last pre-2023 commit of the default branch; when later commits exist they are listed); (4) 15-300 non-test, non-declaration .ts files under src/ of the analysis root; (5) not in the Study 1 corpus (corpus/corpus.json) and not among the 14 repositories of the W1 wild job (PR #114, results/v1.3-wild/selection.json on branch v1.3-wild); (6) preference for well-known references. srcTsFiles excludes *.spec.ts, *.test.ts, __tests__/, test/ and tests/ folders.
